The '''1895 Mexico Census''' was the first census that took place in [[Mexico]] (excluding the 1793 Census which has been lost). It took place on October 20, 1895, and the total population was 12,700,294. The results also showed that most [[Mexican people|Mexicans]] were [[Catholic Church|Catholic]].{{citation needed|date=August 2019}}

==Languages in Mexico==
83.3% of the resident population spoke [[Mexican Spanish|Spanish]] with the remainder of the population mostly speaking Indigenous languages. The most widely spoken indigenous languages were [[Nahuatl]] and [[Mayan languages|Mayan]]. The most widely spoken European language besides Spanish was [[English language|English]].
